question: Which kind of worker should take the task in `state`?

options.local_fast_lane: a cheap local lane; the task is narrow and well specified
options.strong_reasoning_lane: a strong model; the task needs real reasoning or design
options.specialist_tool: a purpose-built tool rather than an agent; deterministic work
options.human_owner: a human; the task needs authority a model does not have
options.no_worker: nothing should take it; it is not actionable

samples.state: A rename across twelve files where every location is already known.
samples.label: local_fast_lane
samples.option_text: a cheap local lane; the task is narrow and well specified

samples.state: Deciding how to structure a module that four other modules will depend on.
samples.label: strong_reasoning_lane
samples.option_text: a strong model; the task needs real reasoning or design

samples.state: Counting occurrences of a symbol across the tree.
samples.label: specialist_tool
samples.option_text: a purpose-built tool rather than an agent; deterministic work

samples.state: Approving a change that spends the owner's money.
samples.label: human_owner
samples.option_text: a human; the task needs authority a model does not have

samples.state: The request asks to make something better without naming what.
samples.label: no_worker
samples.option_text: nothing should take it; it is not actionable

samples.state: A one-line typo fix in a file whose path is given.
samples.label: local_fast_lane
samples.option_text: a cheap local lane; the task is narrow and well specified

samples.state: Diagnosing why a test fails intermittently under load.
samples.label: strong_reasoning_lane
samples.option_text: a strong model; the task needs real reasoning or design

samples.state: Reformatting a file with the project's formatter.
samples.label: specialist_tool
samples.option_text: a purpose-built tool rather than an agent; deterministic work
